title_en: The Position of Shaykh al-Mufid Regarding Shaykh al-Saduq on the Issue of Inadvertence (Sahw) of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)
summary: An examination of the theological differences between Shaykh al-Mufid and Shaykh al-Saduq concerning the possibility of inadvertence (sahw) on the part of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

people: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)
